title: Configurable advanced segment skipping
message: Adds 12 configurable segment-skip categories with explicit control/metadata detection and playback-safe behavior.
features: 12 configurable segment categories including sponsor, promotional, intro, recap, credits and end cards
Skip actions only when a supported explicit control or segment marker is available
Per-category settings in the Options page
Allowlist-aware, rate-limited, fail-open behavior; no media or DRM manipulation
